steps.name: Finally Inside
steps.objective: Go to the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters" and find [Yuran].

steps.name: In a Hurry
steps.objective: Talk to [Yuran] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters", then find [Jerix].

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: %s, I've been waiting for you. My name is Yuran, a disciple of Master Ziskad. Um, %s, are you all right? You look a little exhausted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Iris... Where is Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've come such a long way to see her...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm sorry to tell you this, but Lady Iris isn't at the alliance headquarters right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There are circumstances at the moment. Could you wait a little? You'll be able to see her soon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I understand your disappointment, but Lady Iris is also making preparations of her own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I ask what she's preparing for?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Lady Iris has gone to the Training Forest. She's training there... learning to make the power she's gained truly her own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then if I go to the Training Forest, can I see Iris?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If you're so determined, then go to the Training Forest. But the journey will be far from easy.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Sigh... What is the first thing you want to do when you see Lady Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I want to ask if she's been well.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: ...That's a surprisingly ordinary greeting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm struggling to think of what to say to her. I don't know what she'll say to me either...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I've been talking to myself for too long. Sorry. Anyway, how do I get to the Training Forest?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Jerix will gladly tell you about it. The person in white over there... Already gone.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (All I can do is hope this isn't the wrong person...)

steps.name: Iris' Whereabouts
steps.objective: Talk to [Jerix] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters", then find [Jin].

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Who are you? I haven't seen you before... If the barrier opened to let you in, you must have Lord Ziskad's permission. Then you're the adventurer Lady Iris mentioned.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm the adventurer she mentioned. Where is Iris now? And, and...

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: How tiresome. If you want to see Lady Iris, you need to go to the training grounds. First, get permission to enter from Jin.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: That's all. Don't make me go to any more trouble.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Why are you still here? I'm a busy person, and I went out of my way to make time for you... Jin is over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right. I'll go right away. Thank you, Jerix.

steps.name: Entering the Training Forest
steps.objective: Enter the "Training Forest" and defeat [Secret Forest Summoners] and [Noblesse Spear Dragon Troopers], then find [Shuga].

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Jerix has a loud voice, you see. I heard everything. You're looking for Lady Iris... She went to the training grounds. By now, I imagine she's on the Floating Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Floating Island? How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: There's a path farther inside. Take it. But there's something you should be careful about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a place for training. Is there really anything to be careful about?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: You say that because you know nothing about it. It's a place prepared for warriors, and it has rules of its own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does it? I'd rather learn the rules when I get there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm in a hurry. Could you just give me permission to enter?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Then so be it. Experience it for yourself and learn the rules as you go. It won't be a bad experience... provided you can endure it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? What do you mean...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Very well. You have permission to enter the training grounds. You may go in now. I hope you'll endure all its trials and return as a truly accomplished warrior.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you!

steps.name: No Exceptions
steps.objective: Defeat [Screaming Faces of Death] and [Flame Hell Cowls].

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Having come this far, could you be the adventurer who's here to see Lady Iris? You must want to go even deeper. Hehe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Have you heard about me?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Yes. Lady Iris told me about you. She asked me to speak kindly to a certain adventurer if one came to visit.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: You've done well to come this far, but rules are rules, so please follow my instructions. Even if you're the person Lady Iris mentioned, this is still the Training Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: First, prove yourself here.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Just like the people from many different guilds who've come here to prove themselves. Now, off you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll try.

steps.name: Bilbradha, Keeper of the Floating Island
steps.objective: Talk to [Shuga], then enter the Floating Island and defeat [Athena Assassins], [Secret Forest Warriors], and [Bilbradha]. Then report to [Bilbradha] to turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: You're back. I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew... So these are the rules Jin mentioned. Fight one another in the Training Forest and win...

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Yes, those are the rules of this forest. The Deimos cult that throws the continent into turmoil, the demons and their kin targeting Lady Iris and humanity...

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Lord Ziskad prepared this place to help protect a world filled with those and countless unknown threats.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Many warriors have emerged from here and fought against evil for a long time. I've seen those warriors, but you seem a little different.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Perhaps you could become someone like Lord Ziskad, who is called the Sword God. Even now, many people train hard and dream of becoming a Sword God. Who knows what will happen? Hehe...

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: You'll have to overcome much to get there. Skill matters, of course, but you'll need luck as well.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: I've talked too much. I meant to tell you about Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm listening. Please continue.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: I'm a mage. My work is a little different from that of people in religious orders who believe in gods, so I may say things that sound unkind about Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Please forgive me for that in advance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I understand that you're saying those things out of concern for Iris.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Thank you for understanding. Then I'll continue.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Lady Iris was born a human, not a god... She sensed the Demon King and defeated him, but then realized that something about her choice was different from what she'd expected.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: She lived trapped in a place she may or may not have wished to be. Then someone called to her, and she was able to leave.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: As you know, she then gained Lady Seres's power at the Temple of Seres, earning the right to succeed her.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: To fully accept that right and become a goddess, she must keep training. She has to make that power entirely her own and learn to wield it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Shuga, how do you know where Iris was?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Huh? What was I just talking about? Huh? What? For a moment, I felt as if I wasn't myself... All sorts of things happen in the Training Forest, so don't worry too much about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The air here does feel strangely unsettling. Are you really all right?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: I'm fine. Please keep working hard at your training. Oh, Lady Iris went to the Floating Island, so you should be able to see her there.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Hurry along. And give my regards to Bilbradha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, all right. I'll go, though I'm still... Well, I'd better be off. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: (Shuga stares at %s's back as the adventurer heads deeper into the Floating Island, then sighs.)

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Sigh... I told you that you shouldn't visit so often. Even if you're worried about Lady Iris, this puts me in a difficult position.

steps.name: I Am Muwen
steps.objective: Defeat [Executioner Arch Grim Reapers], [Battle Knight Dealers], and [Iris' Nightmare] in the "Illusion Mist Swamp", then meet Muwen.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Maybe it's because I haven't lost in so long. I was speechless for a moment. Wow...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I've seen plenty of reactions, but this is a first. I don't quite know what to say.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: I'll keep it short. I lost, so do whatever you want. Usually, I make the rules here, but since you won, I'll let you decide this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all right. I hadn't thought about that. I came because I thought I'd be able to see Iris. Oh, and Shuga sends her regards.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Her regards? We had dinner together just yesterday... Oh, Iris? You mean Iris, my big sis?

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Oh, so you're the one who came to see her... She told me about what she saw in her dreams, and I think you're the one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her dreams... So Iris has been watching me in her dreams.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Where is Iris now? I heard she was here...

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Decide on a rule first. Then I'll tell you. Even if you can't think of one, just pick anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. Fine, then. Whenever you have time, make a round of the Floating Island and clean it up. It's a mess from all the guilds using it.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Ugh, there are people who do that already... Hmph. Fine, I'll do it. Happy now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now please tell me where Iris is.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: She went to the Poison Mist Swamp. She decided training there would be better than on the Floating Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Yes, the Poison Mist Swamp.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: There, your weaknesses and the things you need to overcome appear as illusions. If you can defeat those illusions, you can overcome anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does Iris need to overcome?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll have to meet her and talk to her.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Iris keeps enduring it there. She wants to overcome her weaknesses, but it doesn't seem easy.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: I've had to carry her away after she collapsed at the entrance more than once or twice.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Take good care of her. So her human life won't be lonely... And because she may become even lonelier once she's a goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... Iris deserves to be happy. She's someone who should be happy. Thank you. I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Oh, right. I was going to say it's dangerous there too... Oh well. I'm sure they'll manage...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: %s? Is that really you, %s? You made it all the way here? Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's me. It's been so long since we saw each other. It's good to see you, Muwen. How have you been? How did you get to the East Land? I... I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So much has happened. Let's take our time catching up later...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing here now?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Zoe and I have been searching for Iris for a long time. We even visited places you'd been, %s, but we must have kept missing each other.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Then we heard rumors and followed Iris all the way here. There were all sorts of coincidences, but it must all have been the goddess's guidance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But are you the only one here now, Muwen? I heard there were others. Where did they go?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I'm not sure. For now, Lord Ziskad has us helping with Iris's training here. Though all we really do is hurry her outside whenever she faints...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Lord Belosh disappeared somewhere, and Lord Frozen went north. He said he needed to investigate the Deimos cult's movements...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: The others went to help with various incidents around the East Land.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Oh, this isn't what matters right now! I was so happy to see you after so long that I forgot...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Iris is in danger. If we leave her, she'll be swallowed by the darkness inside her again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: The Poison Mist Swamp shows you your weaknesses and the things you must overcome, but they gradually fill you with fear.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: If you can't overcome them, they eat away at you. Like waves slowly wearing down even the hardest rock. Yuran said it becomes more dangerous every time you fail to defeat them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what is Iris fighting?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: The Demon King... That's what Iris fears. She's afraid because the choice she believed was right brought about a different result.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: We think Iris made the best choice she could... Fate has been far too cruel to her. Sometimes it makes me want to blame someone, no matter who it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I understand a little. Iris...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Oh, %s. We can't stand around like this. Sorry for talking so much.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Go and help Iris.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I'll stay here and stop the nightmares carrying memories of that time from getting through. Even someone like me wants to help her. Go! Hurry!

steps.name: Rampage
steps.objective: Defeat the [Devil's Phantom], then meet [Zoe] and [Iris].

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Iris, Iris! Please, listen to me! Keep this up and you'll be in serious trouble! What did I tell you? Please, think about your own health!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come on... That's Zoe's voice! Zoe? Zoe, are you there?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s? Is that you, %s? What're you doing here? No, wait, that's not important right now! No matter what I say, Iris won't wake up, like she can't hear a thing!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? What's wrong with her? Oh, the darkness!! Iris, you're in danger!! Wake up! Wake up, I said!! W-wait... What's that appearing right in front of me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Demon King...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm afraid. Terrified. I feel like r-running away. Iris... Have you been carrying all these feelings this whole time?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Iris, hold on. It'll only take a moment. I'll show you that your choice wasn't wrong... Just hold on a little longer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, wake up!! I'm here now. Wake up from this fear!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Choen, Kazno... I trusted you... Don't do this... I... I... I never wanted this...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please... Please, my choice... What I believed in... Aaaaaaaah!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris!! Wake up!! Iris!! Iris!! Wake up!! Please!! This won't work. I need to get her out of here quickly. But... why is Ull here?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I've come to collect Iris on my master's orders. Stand aside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if I refuse?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Well, then I have no choice. Go to sleep...
